@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GallerySeedRecord:
    world_id: str
    initial_policy: Dict
    ts: str
    sig: str

    def body(self):
        return {"type": "gallery_seed",
                "world_id": self.world_id,
                "initial_policy": dict(self.initial_policy),
                "ts": self.ts}

    def record_hash(self):
        return _hash(self.body())


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PolicyChangeRecord:
    world_id: str
    old_policy_hash: str
    new_policy: Dict
    new_policy_hash: str
    request: Optional[Dict]
    request_hash: Optional[str]
    prev: Optional[str]
    ts: str
    sig: str

    def body(self):
        return {
            "type": "policy_change",
            "world_id": self.world_id,
            "old_policy_hash": self.old_policy_hash,
            "new_policy": dict(self.new_policy),
            "new_policy_hash": self.new_policy_hash,
            "request": self.request,
            "request_hash": self.request_hash,
            "prev": self.prev,
            "ts": self.ts,
        }

    def record_hash(self):
        return _hash(self.body())


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MemberAddedRecord:
    world_id: str
    slot: int
    member_id: str
    member_kind: str
    seed_cert: Dict
    request: Optional[Dict]
    request_hash: Optional[str]
    prev: Optional[str]
    ts: str
    sig: str

    def body(self):
        return {
            "type": "member_added",
            "world_id": self.world_id,
            "slot": int(self.slot),
            "member_id": self.member_id,
            "member_kind": self.member_kind,
            "seed_cert": dict(self.seed_cert),
            "request": self.request,
            "request_hash": self.request_hash,
            "prev": self.prev,
            "ts": self.ts,
        }

    def record_hash(self):
        return _hash(self.body())


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MemberRetiredRecord:
    world_id: str
    slot: int
    member_id: str
    reason: str
    request: Optional[Dict]
    request_hash: Optional[str]
    prev: Optional[str]
    ts: str
    sig: str

    def body(self):
        return {
            "type": "member_retired",
            "world_id": self.world_id,
            "slot": int(self.slot),
            "member_id": self.member_id,
            "reason": self.reason,
            "request": self.request,
            "request_hash": self.request_hash,
            "prev": self.prev,
            "ts": self.ts,
        }

    def record_hash(self):
        return _hash(self.body())


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GalleryCycleRecord:
    world_id: str
    cycle: int
    advances: Tuple[Dict, ...]
    prev: Optional[str]
    ts: str
    sig: str

    def body(self):
        return {
            "type": "gallery_cycle",
            "world_id": self.world_id,
            "cycle": self.cycle,
            "advances": [dict(a) for a in self.advances],
            "prev": self.prev,
            "ts": self.ts,
        }

    def record_hash(self):
        return _hash(self.body())


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RequestRefusedRecord:
    world_id: str
    request_hash: str
    request_type: str
    requester_id: str
    reason: str
    request: Dict
    prev: Optional[str]
    ts: str
    sig: str

    def body(self):
        return {
            "type": "request_refused",
            "world_id": self.world_id,
            "request_hash": self.request_hash,
            "request_type": self.request_type,
            "requester_id": self.requester_id,
            "reason": self.reason,
            "request": dict(self.request),
            "prev": self.prev,
            "ts": self.ts,
        }

    def record_hash(self):
        return _hash(self.body())


# =====================================================================
# GovernedGalleryWorld
# =====================================================================

class GovernedGalleryWorld:
    def __init__(self, keypair, policy):
        if not HAS_CRYPTO:
            raise RuntimeError("cryptography not installed")
        self._keypair = keypair
        self._world_id = _did_from_kp(keypair)
        self._policy = policy
        self._members = {}
        self._records = []
        self._cycle = 0
        self._last_hash = None
        seed_body = {
            "type": "gallery_seed",
            "world_id": self._world_id,
            "initial_policy": policy.to_dict(),
            "ts": _now(),
        }
        self._seed_body = seed_body
        self._seed_sig = keypair.sign(
            _canonical(seed_body)).hex()

    @property
    def world_id(self):
        return self._world_id

    def policy(self):
        return self._policy

    def cycle(self):
        return self._cycle

    def members(self):
        return dict(self._members)

    def records(self):
        return list(self._records)

    def seed_body(self):
        return dict(self._seed_body)

    def seed_sig(self):
        return self._seed_sig

    def last_hash(self):
        return self._last_hash

    # -- Key issuance (keeper only) ------------------------

    def issue_world_key(self, subject_id, tier,
                         valid_until=None):
        if tier not in TIER_RANK:
            raise ValueError(f"unknown tier {tier!r}")
        body = {
            "type": "gallery_world_key",
            "issuer_id": self._world_id,
            "subject_id": subject_id,
            "tier": tier,
            "valid_until": (valid_until
                             or "2099-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"),
            "ts": _now(),
        }
        return GalleryWorldKey(
            issuer_id=self._world_id,
            subject_id=subject_id, tier=tier,
            valid_until=body["valid_until"],
            ts=body["ts"],
            sig=self._keypair.sign(
                _canonical(body)).hex(),
        )

    # -- Keeper-direct operations -------------------------

    def add(self, slot, member):
        """Direct addition by keeper. Bypasses request path."""
        if slot in self._members:
            return None
        if not self._policy.allows_kind(member.kind):
            return None
        if len(self._members) >= self._policy.max_members:
            return None
        cert = {
            "kind": member.kind,
            "world_id": member.world_id(),
            "seed_body": member.seed_body(),
            "seed_sig": member.seed_sig(),
        }
        body = {
            "type": "member_added",
            "world_id": self._world_id,
            "slot": int(slot),
            "member_id": member.world_id(),
            "member_kind": member.kind,
            "seed_cert": cert,
            "request": None, "request_hash": None,
            "prev": self._last_hash,
            "ts": _now(),
        }
        rec = MemberAddedRecord(
            world_id=self._world_id, slot=slot,
            member_id=member.world_id(),
            member_kind=member.kind,
            seed_cert=cert,
            request=None, request_hash=None,
            prev=self._last_hash, ts=body["ts"],
            sig=self._keypair.sign(_canonical(body)).hex(),
        )
        self._records.append(rec)
        self._members[slot] = member
        self._last_hash = rec.record_hash()
        return rec

    def retire(self, slot, reason=""):
        if slot not in self._members:
            return None
        member = self._members[slot]
        body = {
            "type": "member_retired",
            "world_id": self._world_id,
            "slot": int(slot),
            "member_id": member.world_id(),
            "reason": reason,
            "request": None, "request_hash": None,
            "prev": self._last_hash,
            "ts": _now(),
        }
        rec = MemberRetiredRecord(
            world_id=self._world_id, slot=slot,
            member_id=member.world_id(), reason=reason,
            request=None, request_hash=None,
            prev=self._last_hash, ts=body["ts"],
            sig=self._keypair.sign(_canonical(body)).hex(),
        )
        self._records.append(rec)
        del self._members[slot]
        self._last_hash = rec.record_hash()
        return rec

    def change_policy(self, new_policy):
        """Direct policy change by keeper."""
        if not isinstance(new_policy, GalleryPolicy):
            return None
        body = {
            "type": "policy_change",
            "world_id": self._world_id,
            "old_policy_hash": self._policy.policy_hash(),
            "new_policy": new_policy.to_dict(),
            "new_policy_hash": new_policy.policy_hash(),
            "request": None, "request_hash": None,
            "prev": self._last_hash,
            "ts": _now(),
        }
        rec = PolicyChangeRecord(
            world_id=self._world_id,
            old_policy_hash=self._policy.policy_hash(),
            new_policy=new_policy.to_dict(),
            new_policy_hash=new_policy.policy_hash(),
            request=None, request_hash=None,
            prev=self._last_hash, ts=body["ts"],
            sig=self._keypair.sign(_canonical(body)).hex(),
        )
        self._records.append(rec)
        self._policy = new_policy
        self._last_hash = rec.record_hash()
        return rec

    # -- Exterior: request path --------------------------

    def request_add(self, request, member):
        ok, reason = _verify_request(request, self._world_id)
        if not ok:
            return self._refuse(request, "add_member_request",
                                 reason)
        if not world_key_has_tier(request.world_key, "control"):
            return self._refuse(request, "add_member_request",
                                 "insufficient tier")
        if request.member_id != member.world_id():
            return self._refuse(request, "add_member_request",
                                 "member id mismatch")
        if request.member_kind != member.kind:
            return self._refuse(request, "add_member_request",
                                 "member kind mismatch")
        if request.member_seed_hash != _hash(member.seed_body()):
            return self._refuse(request, "add_member_request",
                                 "member seed hash mismatch")
        if not self._policy.allows_kind(member.kind):
            return self._refuse(request, "add_member_request",
                                 f"kind {member.kind!r} "
                                 f"not allowed by policy")
        if request.slot in self._members:
            return self._refuse(request, "add_member_request",
                                 f"slot {request.slot} occupied")
        if len(self._members) >= self._policy.max_members:
            return self._refuse(request, "add_member_request",
                                 f"capacity {self._policy.max_members}"
                                 f" reached")
        cert = {
            "kind": member.kind,
            "world_id": member.world_id(),
            "seed_body": member.seed_body(),
            "seed_sig": member.seed_sig(),
        }
        body = {
            "type": "member_added",
            "world_id": self._world_id,
            "slot": int(request.slot),
            "member_id": member.world_id(),
            "member_kind": member.kind,
            "seed_cert": cert,
            "request": request.body(),
            "request_hash": request.request_hash(),
            "prev": self._last_hash,
            "ts": _now(),
        }
        rec = MemberAddedRecord(
            world_id=self._world_id, slot=request.slot,
            member_id=member.world_id(),
            member_kind=member.kind,
            seed_cert=cert,
            request=request.body(),
            request_hash=request.request_hash(),
            prev=self._last_hash, ts=body["ts"],
            sig=self._keypair.sign(_canonical(body)).hex(),
        )
        self._records.append(rec)
        self._members[request.slot] = member
        self._last_hash = rec.record_hash()
        return rec

    def request_retire(self, request):
        ok, reason = _verify_request(request, self._world_id)
        if not ok:
            return self._refuse(request, "retire_member_request",
                                 reason)
        if not world_key_has_tier(request.world_key, "control"):
            return self._refuse(request, "retire_member_request",
                                 "insufficient tier")
        if request.slot not in self._members:
            return self._refuse(request, "retire_member_request",
                                 f"slot {request.slot} empty")
        member = self._members[request.slot]
        if member.world_id() != request.member_id:
            return self._refuse(request, "retire_member_request",
                                 "member id mismatch")
        body = {
            "type": "member_retired",
            "world_id": self._world_id,
            "slot": int(request.slot),
            "member_id": member.world_id(),
            "reason": request.reason,
            "request": request.body(),
            "request_hash": request.request_hash(),
            "prev": self._last_hash,
            "ts": _now(),
        }
        rec = MemberRetiredRecord(
            world_id=self._world_id, slot=request.slot,
            member_id=member.world_id(),
            reason=request.reason,
            request=request.body(),
            request_hash=request.request_hash(),
            prev=self._last_hash, ts=body["ts"],
            sig=self._keypair.sign(_canonical(body)).hex(),
        )
        self._records.append(rec)
        del self._members[request.slot]
        self._last_hash = rec.record_hash()
        return rec

    def request_change_policy(self, request):
        ok, reason = _verify_request(request, self._world_id)
        if not ok:
            return self._refuse(request,
                                 "change_policy_request", reason)
        if not world_key_has_tier(request.world_key, "terminal"):
            return self._refuse(request,
                                 "change_policy_request",
                                 "insufficient tier")
        try:
            new_policy = GalleryPolicy(
                max_members=request.new_policy["max_members"],
                allowed_kinds=tuple(
                    request.new_policy["allowed_kinds"]))
        except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError) as e:
            return self._refuse(request,
                                 "change_policy_request",
                                 f"malformed policy: {e}")
        body = {
            "type": "policy_change",
            "world_id": self._world_id,
            "old_policy_hash": self._policy.policy_hash(),
            "new_policy": new_policy.to_dict(),
            "new_policy_hash": new_policy.policy_hash(),
            "request": request.body(),
            "request_hash": request.request_hash(),
            "prev": self._last_hash,
            "ts": _now(),
        }
        rec = PolicyChangeRecord(
            world_id=self._world_id,
            old_policy_hash=self._policy.policy_hash(),
            new_policy=new_policy.to_dict(),
            new_policy_hash=new_policy.policy_hash(),
            request=request.body(),
            request_hash=request.request_hash(),
            prev=self._last_hash, ts=body["ts"],
            sig=self._keypair.sign(_canonical(body)).hex(),
        )
        self._records.append(rec)
        self._policy = new_policy
        self._last_hash = rec.record_hash()
        return rec

    def _refuse(self, request, request_type, reason):
        body = {
            "type": "request_refused",
            "world_id": self._world_id,
            "request_hash": request.request_hash(),
            "request_type": request_type,
            "requester_id": request.requester_id,
            "reason": reason,
            "request": request.body(),
            "prev": self._last_hash,
            "ts": _now(),
        }
        rec = RequestRefusedRecord(
            world_id=self._world_id,
            request_hash=request.request_hash(),
            request_type=request_type,
            requester_id=request.requester_id,
            reason=reason,
            request=request.body(),
            prev=self._last_hash, ts=body["ts"],
            sig=self._keypair.sign(_canonical(body)).hex(),
        )
        self._records.append(rec)
        self._last_hash = rec.record_hash()
        return rec

    # -- Interior: cycles --------------------------------

    def grow(self):
        advances = []
        for slot in sorted(self._members):
            member = self._members[slot]
            result = member.grow()
            steps = 0 if result is None else 1
            advances.append({
                "slot": slot,
                "member_id": member.world_id(),
                "member_kind": member.kind,
                "steps_taken": steps,
                "info": result or {},
            })
        self._cycle += 1
        body = {
            "type": "gallery_cycle",
            "world_id": self._world_id,
            "cycle": self._cycle,
            "advances": advances,
            "prev": self._last_hash,
            "ts": _now(),
        }
        rec = GalleryCycleRecord(
            world_id=self._world_id, cycle=self._cycle,
            advances=tuple(advances),
            prev=self._last_hash, ts=body["ts"],
            sig=self._keypair.sign(_canonical(body)).hex(),
        )
        self._records.append(rec)
        self._last_hash = rec.record_hash()
        return rec

    def grow_n(self, n):
        for _ in range(n):
            self.grow()


# =====================================================================
# Verification
# =====================================================================

def verify_governed_log(gallery):
    if not HAS_CRYPTO:
        return (False, "cryptography not installed")
    seed = gallery.seed_body()
    if not _verify_sig(gallery.world_id, seed,
                        gallery.seed_sig()):
        return (False, "seed signature invalid")
    try:
        policy = GalleryPolicy(
            max_members=seed["initial_policy"]["max_members"],
            allowed_kinds=tuple(
                seed["initial_policy"]["allowed_kinds"]))
    except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError) as e:
        return (False, f"malformed initial policy: {e}")
    occupied = {}
    cycle = 0
    prev = None
    refused_hashes = set()
    accepted_hashes = set()
    for i, rec in enumerate(gallery.records()):
        if rec.world_id != gallery.world_id:
            return (False, f"record {i}: world_id mismatch")
        if rec.prev != prev:
            return (False, f"record {i}: prev mismatch")
        if not _verify_sig(gallery.world_id,
                            rec.body(), rec.sig):
            return (False, f"record {i}: signature invalid")
        if isinstance(rec, PolicyChangeRecord):
            if rec.old_policy_hash != policy.policy_hash():
                return (False, f"record {i}: old_policy mismatch")
            try:
                new_policy = GalleryPolicy(
                    max_members=rec.new_policy["max_members"],
                    allowed_kinds=tuple(
                        rec.new_policy["allowed_kinds"]))
            except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError):
                return (False, f"record {i}: malformed policy")
            if new_policy.policy_hash() != rec.new_policy_hash:
                return (False,
                         f"record {i}: new_policy hash mismatch")
            if rec.request_hash is not None:
                if rec.request_hash in accepted_hashes \
                        or rec.request_hash in refused_hashes:
                    return (False,
                             f"record {i}: request hash reused")
                ok, reason = _verify_embedded_request(
                    rec.request, gallery.world_id,
                    "change_policy_request")
                if not ok:
                    return (False,
                             f"record {i}: {reason}")
                accepted_hashes.add(rec.request_hash)
            policy = new_policy
        elif isinstance(rec, MemberAddedRecord):
            if rec.slot in occupied:
                return (False,
                         f"record {i}: slot occupied")
            if not verify_seed_cert(rec.seed_cert):
                return (False,
                         f"record {i}: seed cert invalid")
            if rec.seed_cert["kind"] != rec.member_kind:
                return (False,
                         f"record {i}: cert kind mismatch")
            if not policy.allows_kind(rec.member_kind):
                return (False,
                         f"record {i}: kind not allowed at "
                         f"this point in the log")
            if len(occupied) >= policy.max_members:
                return (False,
                         f"record {i}: capacity exceeded at "
                         f"this point in the log")
            if rec.request_hash is not None:
                if rec.request_hash in accepted_hashes \
                        or rec.request_hash in refused_hashes:
                    return (False,
                             f"record {i}: request hash reused")
                ok, reason = _verify_embedded_request(
                    rec.request, gallery.world_id,
                    "add_member_request")
                if not ok:
                    return (False,
                             f"record {i}: {reason}")
                accepted_hashes.add(rec.request_hash)
            occupied[rec.slot] = rec.member_id
        elif isinstance(rec, MemberRetiredRecord):
            if occupied.get(rec.slot) != rec.member_id:
                return (False,
                         f"record {i}: retirement mismatch")
            if rec.request_hash is not None:
                if rec.request_hash in accepted_hashes \
                        or rec.request_hash in refused_hashes:
                    return (False,
                             f"record {i}: request hash reused")
                ok, reason = _verify_embedded_request(
                    rec.request, gallery.world_id,
                    "retire_member_request")
                if not ok:
                    return (False,
                             f"record {i}: {reason}")
                accepted_hashes.add(rec.request_hash)
            del occupied[rec.slot]
        elif isinstance(rec, GalleryCycleRecord):
            if rec.cycle != cycle + 1:
                return (False,
                         f"record {i}: cycle not monotonic")
            cycle = rec.cycle
            mentioned = {a["slot"] for a in rec.advances}
            if mentioned != set(occupied.keys()):
                return (False,
                         f"record {i}: advances do not match "
                         f"occupied slots")
        elif isinstance(rec, RequestRefusedRecord):
            if rec.request_hash in refused_hashes:
                # duplicate refusal is fine — no-op
                pass
            elif rec.request_hash in accepted_hashes:
                return (False,
                         f"record {i}: refused a request "
                         f"already accepted")
            else:
                refused_hashes.add(rec.request_hash)
                ok, reason = _verify_embedded_request(
                    rec.request, gallery.world_id,
                    rec.request_type)
                if not ok:
                    return (False,
                             f"record {i}: {reason}")
            if rec.requester_id != rec.request.get(
                    "requester_id"):
                return (False,
                         f"record {i}: requester mismatch")
        else:
            return (False, f"record {i}: unknown type")
        prev = rec.record_hash()
    return (True, "governed log verifies")


def _verify_embedded_request(request_dict, gallery_id,
                               expected_type):
    """Verify a request that was embedded in a record."""
    if not isinstance(request_dict, dict):
        return (False, "request not a dict")
    if request_dict.get("type") != expected_type:
        return (False,
                 f"request type {request_dict.get('type')!r} "
                 f"!= {expected_type!r}")
    if request_dict.get("world_id") != gallery_id:
        return (False, "request targets another gallery")
    try:
        wk = GalleryWorldKey.from_dict(
            request_dict["world_key"])
    except (KeyError, ValueError):
        return (False, "malformed world-key")
    if wk.issuer_id != gallery_id:
        return (False, "world-key not issued by this gallery")
    if not verify_world_key(wk, gallery_id):
        return (False, "world-key invalid")
    if wk.subject_id != request_dict["requester_id"]:
        return (False, "world-key subject mismatch")
    if wk.valid_until <= request_dict["ts"]:
        return (False, "world-key expired at request time")
    # Verify request's own signature
    body = {k: v for k, v in request_dict.items()
             if k != "sig"}
    sig = request_dict.get("sig", "")
    if not _verify_sig(request_dict["requester_id"],
                        body, sig):
        return (False, "request signature invalid")
    return (True, "request verifies")


def verify_governed_members(gallery):
    claimed = {}
    for rec in gallery.records():
        if isinstance(rec, GalleryCycleRecord):
            for adv in rec.advances:
                claimed[adv["member_id"]] = (
                    claimed.get(adv["member_id"], 0)
                    + adv["steps_taken"])
    for slot, member in gallery.members().items():
        vlog = member.verify_log()
        if not vlog[0]:
            return (False,
                     f"slot {slot}: log: {vlog[1]}")
        vgrow = member.verify_growth()
        if not vgrow[0]:
            return (False,
                     f"slot {slot}: growth: {vgrow[1]}")
        claim = claimed.get(member.world_id(), 0)
        actual = member.steps()
        if claim != actual:
            return (False,
                     f"slot {slot}: claims {claim}, "
                     f"actual {actual}")
    return (True, "members verify")


def verify_governed_full(gallery):
    v = verify_governed_log(gallery)
    if not v[0]:
        return (False, f"log: {v[1]}")
    v = verify_governed_members(gallery)
    if not v[0]:
        return (False, f"members: {v[1]}")
    return (True, "full verification passes")


# =====================================================================
# Rendering
# =====================================================================

def render_governed(gallery):
    lines = []
    p = gallery.policy()
    lines.append(f"  policy: max_members={p.max_members}  "
                  f"allowed_kinds={sorted(p.allowed_kinds)}")
    lines.append("")
    if not gallery.members():
        lines.append("  (interior is empty)")
        return "\n".join(lines)
    for slot in sorted(gallery.members()):
        m = gallery.members()[slot]
        lines.append(f"  slot {slot}: {m.kind}  "
                      f"steps={m.steps()}")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def refusal_trail(gallery):
    lines = []
    for i, rec in enumerate(gallery.records()):
        if isinstance(rec, RequestRefusedRecord):
            lines.append(
                f"    [{i}] {rec.request_type} from "
                f"{rec.requester_id[:20]}...: {rec.reason}")
    return "\n".join(lines) if lines else "    (no refusals)"


# =====================================================================
# Demo
# =====================================================================

def demo(artifact_dir=None):
    from pathlib import Path
    import json as _json
    from fractal_world_v3 import AtomicFractalWorld, WorldTemplate
    from fractal_grid_world import FractalGridWorld, GridParams
    from chaos_game_world import ChaosGameWorld, SIERPINSKI
    from coupled_ca_world import CoupledCAWorld
    from gallery_world import (
        AtomicFractalMember, FractalGridMember,
        ChaosGameMember, CoupledCAMember,
    )

    if not HAS_CRYPTO:
        raise RuntimeError("demo requires `cryptography`")
    if artifact_dir is None:
        artifact_dir = "artifacts"
    path = Path(artifact_dir) / "gallery_governance"
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    keeper_kp = Ed25519PrivateKey.generate()
    initial_policy = GalleryPolicy(
        max_members=3,
        allowed_kinds=("atomic_fractal", "fractal_grid",
                        "chaos_game", "coupled_ca"))
    gallery = GovernedGalleryWorld(keeper_kp, initial_policy)

    # External actors
    curator_x_kp = Ed25519PrivateKey.generate()
    curator_x_id = _did_from_kp(curator_x_kp)
    curator_y_kp = Ed25519PrivateKey.generate()
    curator_y_id = _did_from_kp(curator_y_kp)
    curator_z_kp = Ed25519PrivateKey.generate()
    curator_z_id = _did_from_kp(curator_z_kp)

    key_x = gallery.issue_world_key(curator_x_id, "control")
    key_y = gallery.issue_world_key(curator_y_id, "observe")
    key_z = gallery.issue_world_key(curator_z_id, "terminal")

    # Build the four kinds of members
    plant_world = AtomicFractalWorld(
        template=WorldTemplate(
            template_id="gallery-plant",
            branch_length=2, max_depth=2),
        pot=(0, 0, 10, 10), initial_tip=(5, 8, 0),
        keypair=Ed25519PrivateKey.generate())
    plant = AtomicFractalMember(plant_world)

    grid_world = FractalGridWorld(
        params=GridParams(rule_number=90, max_gen=8),
        initial_row=[0],
        keypair=Ed25519PrivateKey.generate())
    grid = FractalGridMember(grid_world, max_gen=8)

    chaos_world = ChaosGameWorld(
        preset=SIERPINSKI, growth_mode="seeded_random",
        initial_point=(500, 500),
        keypair=Ed25519PrivateKey.generate(),
        prng_seed=0xFEED)
    chaos = ChaosGameMember(chaos_world, max_steps=30)

    ca_world = CoupledCAWorld(
        rule_a=90, rule_b=90,
        initial_a=[0], initial_b=[12],
        k_a=50, k_b=50,
        keypair=Ed25519PrivateKey.generate())
    ca = CoupledCAMember(ca_world, max_gen=10)

    log = []

    # 1. Keeper adds plant and grid directly
    gallery.add(0, plant)
    log.append(("keeper", "add slot 0: atomic_fractal"))
    gallery.add(1, grid)
    log.append(("keeper", "add slot 1: fractal_grid"))

    # 2. Curator X (control) requests to add chaos to slot 2
    req = sign_add_member(
        gallery.world_id, 2, chaos,
        curator_x_kp, key_x)
    result = gallery.request_add(req, chaos)
    log.append((
        "accepted" if isinstance(result, MemberAddedRecord)
        else "refused",
        f"Curator X add slot 2: chaos_game"
        f" → {getattr(result, 'reason', 'accepted')}"))

    # 3. Curator Y (observe) requests to add CA to slot 3
    req = sign_add_member(
        gallery.world_id, 3, ca,
        curator_y_kp, key_y)
    result = gallery.request_add(req, ca)
    log.append((
        "refused" if isinstance(result, RequestRefusedRecord)
        else "accepted",
        f"Curator Y add slot 3: coupled_ca"
        f" → {getattr(result, 'reason', 'accepted')}"))

    # 4. Curator X requests slot 3 — but capacity is 3 already
    req = sign_add_member(
        gallery.world_id, 3, ca,
        curator_x_kp, key_x)
    result = gallery.request_add(req, ca)
    log.append((
        "refused" if isinstance(result, RequestRefusedRecord)
        else "accepted",
        f"Curator X add slot 3: capacity test"
        f" → {getattr(result, 'reason', 'accepted')}"))

    # 5. Grow — three members
    gallery.grow_n(10)

    # 6. Curator Z (terminal) requests policy change
    new_policy_dict = GalleryPolicy(
        max_members=5,
        allowed_kinds=("atomic_fractal", "fractal_grid",
                        "chaos_game", "coupled_ca")
    ).to_dict()
    req = sign_change_policy(
        gallery.world_id, new_policy_dict,
        curator_z_kp, key_z)
    result = gallery.request_change_policy(req)
    log.append((
        "accepted" if isinstance(result, PolicyChangeRecord)
        else "refused",
        f"Curator Z change policy to max_members=5"
        f" → {getattr(result, 'reason', 'accepted')}"))

    # 7. Curator X retries slot 3 — should succeed now
    req = sign_add_member(
        gallery.world_id, 3, ca,
        curator_x_kp, key_x)
    result = gallery.request_add(req, ca)
    log.append((
        "accepted" if isinstance(result, MemberAddedRecord)
        else "refused",
        f"Curator X add slot 3 after policy change"
        f" → {getattr(result, 'reason', 'accepted')}"))

    # 8. More growth — four members now
    gallery.grow_n(5)

    # 9. Curator X retires the chaos member (control can retire)
    chaos_id = gallery.members()[2].world_id()
    req = sign_retire_member(
        gallery.world_id, 2, chaos_id, "session over",
        curator_x_kp, key_x)
    result = gallery.request_retire(req)
    log.append((
        "accepted" if isinstance(result, MemberRetiredRecord)
        else "refused",
        f"Curator X retire slot 2"
        f" → {getattr(result, 'reason', 'accepted')}"))

    gallery.grow_n(3)

    v_log = verify_governed_log(gallery)
    v_mem = verify_governed_members(gallery)
    v_full = verify_governed_full(gallery)

    print("=" * 74)
    print("The Governed Gallery — interior, exterior, and refusal")
    print("=" * 74)
    print()
    print(f"  Gallery:  {gallery.world_id[:32]}...")
    print(f"  Cycles:   {gallery.cycle()}")
    print(f"  Members:  {len(gallery.members())}")
    print()
    print("  Sequence:")
    for kind, msg in log:
        marker = {"keeper": "·", "accepted": "✓",
                   "refused": "✗"}[kind]
        print(f"    {marker} {msg}")
    print()
    print("  Interior (current state):")
    print(render_governed(gallery))
    print()
    print("  Exterior refusal trail:")
    print(refusal_trail(gallery))
    print()
    print("  Verification:")
    print(f"    log:      {v_log[0]}  ({v_log[1]})")
    print(f"    members:  {v_mem[0]}  ({v_mem[1]})")
    print(f"    full:     {v_full[0]}  ({v_full[1]})")
    print()
    print("  What this establishes:")
    print("    - The gallery has a governed exterior: world-keys,")
    print("      tiers, signed requests, signed refusals.")
    print("    - Keeper can act directly (add, retire, change")
    print("      policy) — bypassing the request path. Both paths")
    print("      are logged. Keeper is the gallery's key.")
    print("    - External actors submit signed requests with a")
    print("      world-key. Tier gates which operations they can")
    print("      request. Policy gates what gets accepted.")
    print("    - Refusals are signed records with specific")
    print("      reasons. No silent failures.")
    print("    - Policy changes are themselves governed — terminal")
    print("      tier only. Old and new policy hashes are in the")
    print("      log, so a verifier reconstructs policy state")
    print("      across changes.")
    print("    - The interior is unchanged: members grow, cycles")
    print("      advance, cross-checks pass. Governance is a")
    print("      layer over the same composite.")
    print()
    print("  Anchor (public domain, Emily Dickinson):")
    print("    'The Soul selects her own Society –'")
    print("    'Then – shuts the Door –'")

    audit = {
        "gallery_id": gallery.world_id,
        "cycles": gallery.cycle(),
        "policy_final": gallery.policy().to_dict(),
        "members": [
            {"slot": s, "kind": m.kind,
             "member_id": m.world_id(), "steps": m.steps()}
            for s, m in sorted(gallery.members().items())
        ],
        "refusal_count": sum(
            1 for r in gallery.records()
            if isinstance(r, RequestRefusedRecord)),
        "verification": {
            "log": v_log[0],
            "members": v_mem[0],
            "full": v_full[0],
        },
    }
    (path / "gallery_governance_demo.json").write_text(
        _json.dumps(audit, indent=2))
    print(f"\n  → {path}/gallery_governance_demo.json")
    return audit
```

def test_tampered_policy_hash_rejected():
    g = _gallery(max_members=2)
    z_kp = _kp()
    z_key = g.issue_world_key(_did_from_kp(z_kp), "terminal")
    new = GalleryPolicy(5, g.policy().allowed_kinds).to_dict()
    req = sign_change_policy(g.world_id, new, z_kp, z_key)
    g.request_change_policy(req)
    # Tamper: change old_policy_hash
    for i, r in enumerate(g.records()):
        if isinstance(r, PolicyChangeRecord):
            g._records[i] = PolicyChangeRecord(
                world_id=r.world_id,
                old_policy_hash="00" * 32,
                new_policy=r.new_policy,
                new_policy_hash=r.new_policy_hash,
                request=r.request, request_hash=r.request_hash,
                prev=r.prev, ts=r.ts, sig=r.sig)
            break
    ok, _ = verify_governed_log(g)
    assert not ok


def test_tampered_request_sig_rejected():
    g = _gallery()
    x_kp = _kp()
    x_key = g.issue_world_key(_did_from_kp(x_kp), "control")
    member = _plant()
    req = sign_add_member(g.world_id, 0, member, x_kp, x_key)
    g.request_add(req, member)
    # Tamper: change request's sig in the record
    for i, r in enumerate(g.records()):
        if isinstance(r, MemberAddedRecord) \
                and r.request is not None:
            new_req = dict(r.request)
            new_req["sig"] = "00" * 64
            g._records[i] = MemberAddedRecord(
                world_id=r.world_id, slot=r.slot,
                member_id=r.member_id,
                member_kind=r.member_kind,
                seed_cert=r.seed_cert,
                request=new_req,
                request_hash=r.request_hash,
                prev=r.prev, ts=r.ts, sig=r.sig)
            break
    ok, _ = verify_governed_log(g)
    assert not ok


def test_duplicate_request_hash_rejected():
    g = _gallery()
    x_kp = _kp()
    x_key = g.issue_world_key(_did_from_kp(x_kp), "control")
    member = _plant()
    req = sign_add_member(g.world_id, 0, member, x_kp, x_key)
    g.request_add(req, member)
    # Manually append a duplicate record reusing the request hash
    for i, r in enumerate(g.records()):
        if isinstance(r, MemberAddedRecord):
            fake = MemberAddedRecord(
                world_id=r.world_id, slot=1,
                member_id=_plant().world_id(),
                member_kind="atomic_fractal",
                seed_cert=_plant().seed_body(),  # placeholder
                request=r.request,
                request_hash=r.request_hash,
                prev=g._last_hash,
                ts=r.ts,
                sig=g._keypair.sign(
                    _canonical({
                        "type": "member_added",
                        "world_id": r.world_id, "slot": 1,
                        "member_id": "x", "member_kind":
                        "atomic_fractal", "seed_cert": {},
                        "request": r.request,
                        "request_hash": r.request_hash,
                        "prev": g._last_hash, "ts": r.ts,
                    })).hex())
            g._records.append(fake)
            break
    ok, reason = verify_governed_log(g)
    assert not ok
    assert "reused" in reason.lower()


# -- Demo --

def test_demo(tmp_path):
    audit = demo(artifact_dir=str(tmp_path))
    assert audit["verification"]["log"] is True
    assert audit["verification"]["members"] is True
    assert audit["verification"]["full"] is True
    assert audit["refusal_count"] >= 2  # at least tier + capacity
    assert audit["policy_final"]["max_members"] == 5
    assert (tmp_path / "gallery_governance" /
            "gallery_governance_demo.json").exists()
```

Demo shape

  Sequence:
    · keeper add slot 0: atomic_fractal
    · keeper add slot 1: fractal_grid
    ✓ Curator X add slot 2: chaos_game → accepted
    ✗ Curator Y add slot 3: coupled_ca → insufficient tier
    ✗ Curator X add slot 3: capacity test → capacity 3 reached
    ✓ Curator Z change policy to max_members=5 → accepted
    ✓ Curator X add slot 3 after policy change → accepted
    ✓ Curator X retire slot 2 → accepted

  Interior (current state):
    policy: max_members=5  allowed_kinds=[...]
    slot 0: atomic_fractal  steps=18
    slot 1: fractal_grid    steps=8
    slot 3: coupled_ca      steps=13

  Exterior refusal trail:
    [3] add_member_request from did:key:...: insufficient tier
    [5] add_member_request from did:key:...: capacity 3 reached

  Verification:
    log:      True
    members:  True
    full:     True

What this establishes

Governance is an artifact, not a policy. A refusal is a RequestRefusedRecord — signed, timestamped, with the full request embedded and a specific reason. An auditor can reconstruct exactly who asked for what, when, and why it was denied. No silent failures. Same discipline as v3's RefusalRecord, applied to the composite.

Tier gating is enforced at two levels. The gallery checks the tier on request (_verify_request → world_key_has_tier). The verifier independently checks that every accepted request's world-key had a sufficient tier at the recorded timestamp — so a compromised gallery can't retroactively accept a request it logged at observe-tier. test_request_change_policy_terminal_only covers the two-tier split; test_full_verifies_with_requests covers the full path.

The request hash is a nonce. accepted_hashes and refused_hashes are tracked separately in verify_governed_log. A hash appearing in both, or accepted twice, fails verification. test_duplicate_request_hash_rejected forces this. It's a small guarantee but a real one — a request can be acted on at most once.

Direct keeper path is honest, not hidden. The keeper's add(), retire(), change_policy() produce the same record types as requests, with request=None. The verifier treats them the same way (signature check; no request to verify). This isn't a loophole — the keeper is the gallery's key, and the gallery's key signs the log. If the keeper wants an audit trail, they sign a request. If they don't, the record still exists, just without a request.

Policy is reconstructible across changes. The verifier maintains a policy variable, updates it on each PolicyChangeRecord, and re-checks allowed_kinds and capacity at each MemberAddedRecord against the policy at that point in the log. test_full_verifies_policy_change walks the sequence: add under max_members=2, then policy change to max_members=5, then a second add that would have failed under the old policy — and the verifier accepts the second add because the policy at that point allows it. This is the same discipline as fractal_world_v3's branching: state is what the log says, replayed in order.

The honest limits

· No key revocation. A world-key, once issued, is valid until valid_until. If a keeper wants to revoke a key early, there's no world_key_revoked record and no check against one. This would be a natural next-cycle addition — a world_key_revoked record type, and the verifier tracking revoked subjects against request timestamps.
· Request replay is prevented by hash only. The verifier rejects two records sharing a request hash. It does not reject a request that was refused once and then resubmitted with a new timestamp — that would produce two different hashes, both refused, both valid. In practice this is fine (a resubmitted request is a new request); a stricter model would add a "no more than N requests per subject per window" rule.
· Refused requests still in the log forever. A refusal record is permanent. Over time the log will contain the full refusal history of every external actor. This is honest and auditable, but if there are many actors submitting many refusals, the log grows. The request_hash allows deduplication at the reader's end; a future version could allow summarized refusal ranges.
· allowed_kinds is a whitelist, not a quota. A gallery with max_members=10 and four allowed kinds could contain ten atomic_fractal members and no others. A richer policy would allow per-kind caps (max_per_kind: {"atomic_fractal": 3, ...}), for "at least one of each kind" requirements, and for dynamic rebalancing. Not built; noted.
· No delegated trust. A world-key is either issued by the gallery or not. There's no "gallery A recognizes gallery B's keys." That's C72 territory — inter-federation recognition — and would compose on top of this naturally (a RecognizedGalleryKey verified via C72's recognition chain).
· No keeper rotation. The gallery's key is fixed at construction. Rotating it would need a keeper_rotation record signed by both old and new keys (mirroring C28's manifest rotation). Natural next step; not built.

What's next

Four directions, each genuinely different:

1. Key revocation and keeper rotation. A world_key_revoked record type and a keeper_rotation record. The verifier tracks both and refuses requests that used a revoked key or pre-rotation keeper. Small, focused, closes the biggest named gap. Tests whether "mutable-but-verifiable" generalizes to authentication.
2. Per-kind quotas. max_per_kind: dict and min_per_kind: dict. The verifier checks both against the occupied set at each MemberAddedRecord. The policy becomes richer without the governance mechanism changing. Tests whether the policy model generalizes.
3. Meta-coupling. The gallery watches its own members' rates and modulates their next grow call (speed up slow ones, throttle fast ones). This is the "interior learning from itself" direction — a new interior dynamic, orthogonal to governance. Would produce visible divergence between the "open" and "governed" galleries.
4. Cross-gallery key recognition. A gallery trusts a second gallery's world-keys via a RecognizedGalleryKey certificate. Composes C72's recognition (or a simplified version) with C88's world-keys. Opens the door to federated galleries, which is where the arc's federation theme finally meets the world theme.

My instinct: key revocation and keeper rotation. It's the smallest piece that closes the biggest named gap — the authentication layer's first "mutable but verifiable" test. If revocation and rotation work cleanly through the log, the governance machinery is robust rather than merely correct, and per-kind quotas / meta-coupling / cross-gallery recognition all sit on a proven foundation.

But meta-coupling is the most interesting direction — the interior learning from itself in a way that's visible in the members' shapes. If you'd rather see the gallery come alive than harden its authentication, that's the one.

Which would you like?


::Meta-coupling was my instinct. But when you say: “smallest piece that closes the biggest named gap”, that means let’s go with your instinct and look at key revocation and keeper rotation: ➡️


The design

Two new record types, one extended verifier that walks the keeper timeline:

KeeperRotationRecord — signed by both the old keeper (attesting "I'm transferring") and the new keeper (attesting "I accept"). After this record, all new records are signed by the new keeper.

WorldKeyRevokedRecord — signed by the current keeper, names a specific key by hash, with an effective_at timestamp. Requests applied at or after effective_at are refused. Requests applied before remain valid (they were legitimate when accepted).

The verifier's central change: it tracks the current keeper as it walks the log, rather than verifying everything against the seed's world_id. Rotation updates the tracked keeper mid-walk. Revocation updates a set of (key_hash, effective_at) pairs. Each accepted request is verified against the state at its apply-time, not the present.

gallery_revocation.py

```python
"""
gallery_revocation.py — key revocation and keeper rotation.

Extends gallery_governance with two record types and a verifier
that walks the keeper timeline.

Design decisions:
  - World id is frozen at construction (= initial keeper's did).
    It identifies the gallery, not the keeper.
  - Record-signing rotates. The current keeper (reconstructed from
    the log) signs each record. Rotation is a mid-log event;
    before it, old keeper signs; after it, new keeper signs.
  - World-keys are signed by their issuer (the keeper who issued
    them). Old keys remain valid after rotation — the subject
    shouldn't have to re-enroll. Revocation is by hash; once a key
    is revoked, requests applied at or after effective_at are
    refused.
  - Verifier tracks current_keeper and revoked_keys as it walks.
    Accepted requests are checked against state-at-apply-time.

Honest limits:
  - Keys issued after rotation are not exercised in this sketch
    (runtime _verify_request still expects issuer == world_id).
    Full post-rotation issuance is a v0.2 concern.
  - No forward secrecy. Records signed by K1 before rotation
    remain signed by K1; compromise of K1 before rotation is not
    retroactively detectable.
  - Verifier does not re-derive *refusal* reasons — it trusts the
    gallery's claim for refused requests. Accepted requests are
    fully re-derived.
"""

import hashlib
import json
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

try:
    from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.ed25519 import (
        Ed25519PrivateKey, Ed25519PublicKey)
    from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import serialization
    from cryptography.exceptions import InvalidSignature
    HAS_CRYPTO = True
except ImportError:
    HAS_CRYPTO = False

from gallery_governance import (
    GalleryPolicy, GalleryWorldKey, verify_world_key,
    world_key_has_tier,
    GovernedGalleryWorld,
    GallerySeedRecord, PolicyChangeRecord, MemberAddedRecord,
    MemberRetiredRecord, GalleryCycleRecord,
    RequestRefusedRecord,
    verify_governed_members,
    _did_from_kp, _canonical, _hash, _now, _pubkey_from_did,
    _verify_sig,
)


# =====================================================================
# New record types
# =====================================================================

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class KeeperRotationRecord:
    world_id: str
    old_keeper_id: str
    new_keeper_id: str
    prev: Optional[str]
    ts: str
    sig_old: str
    sig_new: str

    def rotation_body(self):
        return {
            "type": "keeper_rotation",
            "world_id": self.world_id,
            "old_keeper_id": self.old_keeper_id,
            "new_keeper_id": self.new_keeper_id,
            "prev": self.prev,
            "ts": self.ts,
        }

    def record_hash(self):
        return _hash(self.rotation_body())


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class WorldKeyRevokedRecord:
    world_id: str
    revoked_subject_id: str
    key_hash: str
    reason: str
    effective_at: str
    prev: Optional[str]
    ts: str
    sig: str

    def body(self):
        return {
            "type": "world_key_revoked",
            "world_id": self.world_id,
            "revoked_subject_id": self.revoked_subject_id,
            "key_hash": self.key_hash,
            "reason": self.reason,
            "effective_at": self.effective_at,
            "prev": self.prev,
            "ts": self.ts,
        }

    def record_hash(self):
        return _hash(self.body())


# =====================================================================
# RevocableGalleryWorld
# =====================================================================

class RevocableGalleryWorld(GovernedGalleryWorld):
    def __init__(self, keypair, policy):
        super().__init__(keypair, policy)
        self._current_keeper_id = self._world_id
        self._valid_keepers = {self._world_id}
        self._revoked_keys = {}

    @property
    def current_keeper_id(self):
        return self._current_keeper_id

    def revoke_world_key(self, key, reason=""):
        """Revoke a world-key. Only the current keeper can revoke."""
        if not HAS_CRYPTO:
            raise RuntimeError("cryptography not installed")
        if key.issuer_id != self._current_keeper_id:
            raise ValueError(
                "only the current keeper can revoke a key "
                "issued by themselves")
        key_hash = _hash(key.body())
        body = {
            "type": "world_key_revoked",
            "world_id": self._world_id,
            "revoked_subject_id": key.subject_id,
            "key_hash": key_hash,
            "reason": reason,
            "effective_at": _now(),
            "prev": self._last_hash,
            "ts": _now(),
        }
        rec = WorldKeyRevokedRecord(
            world_id=self._world_id,
            revoked_subject_id=key.subject_id,
            key_hash=key_hash,
            reason=reason,
            effective_at=body["effective_at"],
            prev=self._last_hash,
            ts=body["ts"],
            sig=self._keypair.sign(
                _canonical(body)).hex(),
        )
        self._records.append(rec)
        self._revoked_keys[key_hash] = body["effective_at"]
        self._last_hash = rec.record_hash()
        return rec

    def rotate_keeper(self, new_keeper_kp):
        """Rotate to a new keeper. Both old and new co-sign."""
        if not HAS_CRYPTO:
            raise RuntimeError("cryptography not installed")
        new_id = _did_from_kp(new_keeper_kp)
        if new_id == self._current_keeper_id:
            raise ValueError("new keeper equals current keeper")
        body = {
            "type": "keeper_rotation",
            "world_id": self._world_id,
            "old_keeper_id": self._current_keeper_id,
            "new_keeper_id": new_id,
            "prev": self._last_hash,
            "ts": _now(),
        }
        sig_old = self._keypair.sign(
            _canonical(body)).hex()
        sig_new = new_keeper_kp.sign(
            _canonical(body)).hex()
        rec = KeeperRotationRecord(
            world_id=self._world_id,
            old_keeper_id=self._current_keeper_id,
            new_keeper_id=new_id,
            prev=self._last_hash,
            ts=body["ts"],
            sig_old=sig_old,
            sig_new=sig_new,
        )
        self._records.append(rec)
        self._keypair = new_keeper_kp
        self._current_keeper_id = new_id
        self._valid_keepers.add(new_id)
        self._last_hash = rec.record_hash()
        return rec

    def is_key_revoked(self, key):
        return _hash(key.body()) in self._revoked_keys


# =====================================================================
# Verification
# =====================================================================

def _verify_accepted_request(
    request_dict, world_id, valid_keepers,
    revoked_keys, apply_ts, expected_type,
):
    """Verify an embedded request that was *accepted*. All checks
    including revocation at apply-time. Returns (ok, reason)."""
    if not isinstance(request_dict, dict):
        return (False, "request not a dict")
    if request_dict.get("type") != expected_type:
        return (False,
                 f"request type {request_dict.get('type')!r} "
                 f"!= {expected_type!r}")
    if request_dict.get("world_id") != world_id:
        return (False, "request targets another gallery")
    try:
        wk = GalleryWorldKey.from_dict(request_dict["world_key"])
    except (KeyError, ValueError):
        return (False, "malformed world-key")
    if wk.issuer_id not in valid_keepers:
        return (False,
                 f"world-key issuer {wk.issuer_id[:16]}... "
                 f"is not a valid keeper")
    if not verify_world_key(wk, wk.issuer_id):
        return (False, "world-key signature invalid")
    if wk.subject_id != request_dict["requester_id"]:
        return (False, "world-key subject mismatch")
    if wk.valid_until <= request_dict["ts"]:
        return (False, "world-key expired at request time")
    key_hash = _hash(wk.body())
    if key_hash in revoked_keys:
        if revoked_keys[key_hash] <= apply_ts:
            return (False,
                     f"world-key revoked at "
                     f"{revoked_keys[key_hash]}, "
                     f"applied at {apply_ts}")
    body = {k: v for k, v in request_dict.items()
             if k != "sig"}
    if not _verify_sig(request_dict["requester_id"],
                        body, request_dict["sig"]):
        return (False, "request signature invalid")
    return (True, "request verifies")


def _verify_refused_request(
    request_dict, world_id, valid_keepers,
):
    """Verify an embedded request that was *refused*.
    Verifies the request is well-formed; does not re-derive
    the refusal reason (gallery's claim). Returns (ok, reason)."""
    if not isinstance(request_dict, dict):
        return (False, "request not a dict")
    if request_dict.get("world_id") != world_id:
        return (False, "request targets another gallery")
    try:
        wk = GalleryWorldKey.from_dict(request_dict["world_key"])
    except (KeyError, ValueError):
        return (False, "malformed world-key")
    if not verify_world_key(wk, wk.issuer_id):
        return (False, "world-key signature invalid")
    body = {k: v for k, v in request_dict.items()
             if k != "sig"}
    if not _verify_sig(request_dict["requester_id"],
                        body, request_dict["sig"]):
        return (False, "request signature invalid")
    return (True, "refused request verifies")


def verify_revocable_governed_log(gallery):
    """Extended verifier: keeper timeline + revocation set."""
    if not HAS_CRYPTO:
        return (False, "cryptography not installed")
    seed = gallery.seed_body()
    current_keeper = seed["world_id"]
    valid_keepers = {current_keeper}
    revoked_keys = {}

    if not _verify_sig(current_keeper, seed,
                        gallery.seed_sig()):
        return (False, "seed signature invalid")
    try:
        policy = GalleryPolicy(
            max_members=seed["initial_policy"]["max_members"],
            allowed_kinds=tuple(
                seed["initial_policy"]["allowed_kinds"]))
    except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError) as e:
        return (False, f"malformed initial policy: {e}")

    occupied = {}
    cycle = 0
    prev = None
    accepted_hashes = set()
    refused_hashes = set()

    for i, rec in enumerate(gallery.records()):
        if rec.world_id != gallery.world_id:
            return (False, f"record {i}: world_id mismatch")
        if rec.prev != prev:
            return (False, f"record {i}: prev mismatch")

        if isinstance(rec, KeeperRotationRecord):
            if rec.old_keeper_id != current_keeper:
                return (False,
                         f"record {i}: old keeper "
                         f"{rec.old_keeper_id[:16]}... "
                         f"!= current "
                         f"{current_keeper[:16]}...")
            body = rec.rotation_body()
            if not _verify_sig(rec.old_keeper_id, body,
                                rec.sig_old):
                return (False,
                         f"record {i}: sig_old invalid")
            if not _verify_sig(rec.new_keeper_id, body,
                                rec.sig_new):
                return (False,
                         f"record {i}: sig_new invalid")
            valid_keepers.add(rec.new_keeper_id)
            current_keeper = rec.new_keeper_id
        else:
            if not _verify_sig(current_keeper,
                                rec.body(), rec.sig):
                return (False,
                         f"record {i}: signature invalid "
                         f"against keeper "
                         f"{current_keeper[:16]}...")

            if isinstance(rec, WorldKeyRevokedRecord):
                revoked_keys[rec.key_hash] = rec.effective_at

            elif isinstance(rec, PolicyChangeRecord):
                if rec.old_policy_hash != policy.policy_hash():
                    return (False,
                             f"record {i}: old_policy mismatch")
                try:
                    new_policy = GalleryPolicy(
                        max_members=rec.new_policy["max_members"],
                        allowed_kinds=tuple(
                            rec.new_policy["allowed_kinds"]))
                except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError):
                    return (False,
                             f"record {i}: malformed policy")
                if new_policy.policy_hash() != rec.new_policy_hash:
                    return (False,
                             f"record {i}: new_policy hash "
                             f"mismatch")
                if rec.request_hash is not None:
                    if rec.request_hash in accepted_hashes \
                            or rec.request_hash in refused_hashes:
                        return (False,
                                 f"record {i}: request hash "
                                 f"reused")
                    ok, reason = _verify_accepted_request(
                        rec.request, gallery.world_id,
                        valid_keepers, revoked_keys,
                        rec.ts, "change_policy_request")
                    if not ok:
                        return (False,
                                 f"record {i}: {reason}")
                    accepted_hashes.add(rec.request_hash)
                policy = new_policy

            elif isinstance(rec, MemberAddedRecord):
                if rec.slot in occupied:
                    return (False,
                             f"record {i}: slot occupied")
                if not policy.allows_kind(rec.member_kind):
                    return (False,
                             f"record {i}: kind not allowed")
                if len(occupied) >= policy.max_members:
                    return (False,
                             f"record {i}: capacity exceeded")
                if rec.request_hash is not None:
                    if rec.request_hash in accepted_hashes \
                            or rec.request_hash in refused_hashes:
                        return (False,
                                 f"record {i}: request hash "
                                 f"reused")
                    ok, reason = _verify_accepted_request(
                        rec.request, gallery.world_id,
                        valid_keepers, revoked_keys,
                        rec.ts, "add_member_request")
                    if not ok:
                        return (False,
                                 f"record {i}: {reason}")
                    accepted_hashes.add(rec.request_hash)
                occupied[rec.slot] = rec.member_id

            elif isinstance(rec, MemberRetiredRecord):
                if occupied.get(rec.slot) != rec.member_id:
                    return (False,
                             f"record {i}: retirement mismatch")
                if rec.request_hash is not None:
                    if rec.request_hash in accepted_hashes \
                            or rec.request_hash in refused_hashes:
                        return (False,
                                 f"record {i}: request hash "
                                 f"reused")
                    ok, reason = _verify_accepted_request(
                        rec.request, gallery.world_id,
                        valid_keepers, revoked_keys,
                        rec.ts, "retire_member_request")
                    if not ok:
                        return (False,
                                 f"record {i}: {reason}")
                    accepted_hashes.add(rec.request_hash)
                del occupied[rec.slot]

            elif isinstance(rec, GalleryCycleRecord):
                if rec.cycle != cycle + 1:
                    return (False,
                             f"record {i}: cycle not monotonic")
                cycle = rec.cycle
                mentioned = {a["slot"] for a in rec.advances}
                if mentioned != set(occupied.keys()):
                    return (False,
                             f"record {i}: advances do not "
                             f"match occupied slots")

            elif isinstance(rec, RequestRefusedRecord):
                if rec.request_hash in refused_hashes:
                    pass  # duplicate refusal — no-op
                elif rec.request_hash in accepted_hashes:
                    return (False,
                             f"record {i}: refused a request "
                             f"already accepted")
                else:
                    refused_hashes.add(rec.request_hash)
                    ok, reason = _verify_refused_request(
                        rec.request, gallery.world_id,
                        valid_keepers)
                    if not ok:
                        return (False,
                                 f"record {i}: {reason}")
                if rec.requester_id != rec.request.get(
                        "requester_id"):
                    return (False,
                             f"record {i}: requester mismatch")
            else:
                return (False, f"record {i}: unknown type")

        prev = rec.record_hash()

    return (True, "revocable governed log verifies")


def verify_revocable_full(gallery):
    v = verify_revocable_governed_log(gallery)
    if not v[0]:
        return (False, f"log: {v[1]}")
    v = verify_governed_members(gallery)
    if not v[0]:
        return (False, f"members: {v[1]}")
    return (True, "full verification passes")


# =====================================================================
# Rendering
# =====================================================================

def render_log_summary(gallery):
    """Compact log view with markers for rotation and revocation."""
    lines = []
    for i, rec in enumerate(gallery.records()):
        if isinstance(rec, KeeperRotationRecord):
            lines.append(
                f"    [{i}] ROTATE  {rec.old_keeper_id[:12]}... "
                f"→ {rec.new_keeper_id[:12]}...")
        elif isinstance(rec, WorldKeyRevokedRecord):
            lines.append(
                f"    [{i}] REVOKE  {rec.revoked_subject_id[:16]}... "
                f"({rec.reason})")
        elif isinstance(rec, MemberAddedRecord):
            marker = "REQ" if rec.request_hash else "KEEP"
            lines.append(
                f"    [{i}] {marker:5s}  add slot {rec.slot}: "
                f"{rec.member_kind}")
        elif isinstance(rec, MemberRetiredRecord):
            marker = "REQ" if rec.request_hash else "KEEP"
            lines.append(
                f"    [{i}] {marker:5s}  retire slot {rec.slot}")
        elif isinstance(rec, PolicyChangeRecord):
            marker = "REQ" if rec.request_hash else "KEEP"
            lines.append(
                f"    [{i}] {marker:5s}  policy → "
                f"max_members={rec.new_policy['max_members']}")
        elif isinstance(rec, RequestRefusedRecord):
            lines.append(
                f"    [{i}] REFUS  {rec.request_type} "
                f"({rec.reason})")
        elif isinstance(rec, GalleryCycleRecord):
            lines.append(f"    [{i}] cycle {rec.cycle} "
                          f"({len(rec.advances)} members)")
    return "\n".join(lines) if lines else "    (empty)"


# =====================================================================
# Demo
# =====================================================================

def demo(artifact_dir=None):
    from pathlib import Path
    import json as _json
    from gallery_world import (
        AtomicFractalMember, FractalGridMember,
        ChaosGameMember, CoupledCAMember,
    )
    from fractal_world_v3 import AtomicFractalWorld, WorldTemplate
    from fractal_grid_world import FractalGridWorld, GridParams
    from chaos_game_world import ChaosGameWorld, SIERPINSKI
    from coupled_ca_world import CoupledCAWorld

    if not HAS_CRYPTO:
        raise RuntimeError("demo requires `cryptography`")
    if artifact_dir is None:
        artifact_dir = "artifacts"
    path = Path(artifact_dir) / "gallery_revocation"
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    keeper_kp_1 = Ed25519PrivateKey.generate()
    keeper_kp_2 = Ed25519PrivateKey.generate()
    initial_policy = GalleryPolicy(
        max_members=3,
        allowed_kinds=("atomic_fractal", "fractal_grid"))
    gallery = RevocableGalleryWorld(keeper_kp_1, initial_policy)

    x_kp = Ed25519PrivateKey.generate()
    x_id = _did_from_kp(x_kp)
    y_kp = Ed25519PrivateKey.generate()
    y_id = _did_from_kp(y_kp)
    z_kp = Ed25519PrivateKey.generate()
    z_id = _did_from_kp(z_kp)

    x_key = gallery.issue_world_key(x_id, "control")
    y_key = gallery.issue_world_key(y_id, "observe")
    z_key = gallery.issue_world_key(z_id, "terminal")

    # Members
    def make_plant():
        return AtomicFractalMember(AtomicFractalWorld(
            template=WorldTemplate(
                template_id="t", branch_length=2, max_depth=2),
            pot=(0, 0, 10, 10), initial_tip=(5, 8, 0),
            keypair=Ed25519PrivateKey.generate()))

    def make_grid():
        return FractalGridMember(FractalGridWorld(
            params=GridParams(rule_number=90, max_gen=5),
            initial_row=[0],
            keypair=Ed25519PrivateKey.generate()), max_gen=5)

    def make_chaos():
        return ChaosGameMember(ChaosGameWorld(
            preset=SIERPINSKI, growth_mode="seeded_random",
            initial_point=(500, 500),
            keypair=Ed25519PrivateKey.generate(),
            prng_seed=0xABCD), max_steps=20)

    # 1. K1 adds plant directly
    gallery.add(0, make_plant())

    # 2. X (control) requests add grid → accepted
    from gallery_governance import (
        sign_add_member, sign_retire_member,
        sign_change_policy,
    )
    grid1 = make_grid()
    req = sign_add_member(
        gallery.world_id, 1, grid1, x_kp, x_key)
    gallery.request_add(req, grid1)

    # 3. Y (observe) requests add grid → refused (tier)
    grid2 = make_grid()
    req = sign_add_member(
        gallery.world_id, 2, grid2, y_kp, y_key)
    gallery.request_add(req, grid2)

    # 4. K1 revokes Y's key
    gallery.revoke_world_key(y_key, "policy violation")

    # 5. Y retries → refused (revoked)
    grid2b = make_grid()
    req = sign_add_member(
        gallery.world_id, 2, grid2b, y_kp, y_key)
    gallery.request_add(req, grid2b)

    # 6. K1 rotates to K2
    gallery.rotate_keeper(keeper_kp_2)

    # 7. Z (terminal) requests policy change → accepted (K2 signs)
    new_policy = GalleryPolicy(
        max_members=5,
        allowed_kinds=("atomic_fractal", "fractal_grid",
                        "chaos_game"))
    req = sign_change_policy(
        gallery.world_id, new_policy.to_dict(), z_kp, z_key)
    gallery.request_change_policy(req)

    # 8. X (control) requests add chaos → accepted
    chaos = make_chaos()
    req = sign_add_member(
        gallery.world_id, 2, chaos, x_kp, x_key)
    gallery.request_add(req, chaos)

    # 9. X retires the grid from slot 1 → accepted
    grid1_id = gallery.members()[1].world_id()
    req = sign_retire_member(
        gallery.world_id, 1, grid1_id, "done",
        x_kp, x_key)
    gallery.request_retire(req)

    # 10. Grow
    gallery.grow_n(5)

    v_log = verify_revocable_governed_log(gallery)
    v_full = verify_revocable_full(gallery)

    print("=" * 74)
    print("Revocation + Rotation — the gallery endures")
    print("=" * 74)
    print()
    print(f"  Gallery:        {gallery.world_id[:32]}...")
    print(f"  Initial keeper: {gallery.world_id[:24]}...")
    print(f"  Current keeper: {gallery.current_keeper_id[:24]}...")
    print(f"  Cycles:         {gallery.cycle()}")
    print(f"  Members:        {len(gallery.members())}")
    print()
    print("  Log:")
    print(render_log_summary(gallery))
    print()
    print("  Verification:")
    print(f"    revocable log:  {v_log[0]}  ({v_log[1]})")
    print(f"    full:           {v_full[0]}  ({v_full[1]})")
    print()
    print("  What this establishes:")
    print("    - The verifier walks the keeper timeline. Records")
    print("      before rotation verify against K1; records after")
    print("      verify against K2. Rotation is signed by both.")
    print("    - Revocation is a signed record. Requests using a")
    print("      revoked key are refused by the gallery *and*")
    print("      caught by the verifier independently.")
    print("    - Revocation is temporal: requests applied before")
    print("      effective_at remain valid; those after are")
    print("      refused. The verifier checks state-at-apply-time.")
    print("    - Old keys survive rotation (they were issued by")
    print("      K1, which was a valid keeper at issue time).")
    print("      Rotation doesn't invalidate prior grants.")
    print()
    print("  Honest limits:")
    print("    - Post-rotation key issuance is out of scope here.")
    print("    - Compromise of K1 before rotation is not")
    print("      retroactively detectable.")
    print("    - Verifier trusts refusals' stated reasons.")
    print()
    print("  Anchor (public domain, Emily Dickinson):")
    print("    'After great pain, a formal feeling comes –'")
    print("    'The Nerves sit ceremonious, like Tombs –'")

    audit = {
        "gallery_id": gallery.world_id,
        "initial_keeper": gallery.world_id,
        "current_keeper": gallery.current_keeper_id,
        "rotated": gallery.current_keeper_id != gallery.world_id,
        "cycles": gallery.cycle(),
        "members": [
            {"slot": s, "kind": m.kind, "steps": m.steps()}
            for s, m in sorted(gallery.members().items())
        ],
        "revoked_key_count": len(gallery._revoked_keys),
        "refusal_count": sum(
            1 for r in gallery.records()
            if isinstance(r, RequestRefusedRecord)),
        "verification": {
            "revocable_log": v_log[0],
            "full": v_full[0],
        },
    }
    (path / "gallery_revocation_demo.json").write_text(
        _json.dumps(audit, indent=2))
    print(f"\n  → {path}/gallery_revocation_demo.json")
    return audit
```

    return Ed25519PrivateKey.generate()


def _gallery(max_members=3):
    return RevocableGalleryWorld(
        _kp(), GalleryPolicy(

def test_rotation_record_verifies():
    g = _gallery()
    g.add(0, _plant())
    k2 = _kp()
    rec = g.rotate_keeper(k2)
    assert isinstance(rec, KeeperRotationRecord)
    assert rec.old_keeper_id == g.world_id

    k2 = _kp()

    assert g.current_keeper_id == _did_from_kp(k2)

def test_record_signed_by_old_keeper_after_rotation_fails():
    """A record appended after rotation, but signed by K1, is
    detected by the verifier."""
    g = _gallery()
    k1 = g._keypair  # save old keeper
    k2 = _kp()
    g.rotate_keeper(k2)
    # Manually append a record signed by K1
    grid = _grid()
    cert = {"kind": grid.kind,
            "world_id": grid.world_id(),
            "seed_body": grid.seed_body(),
            "seed_sig": grid.seed_sig()}
    body = {
        "type": "member_added",
        "world_id": g.world_id,
        "slot": 0,
        "member_id": grid.world_id(),
        "member_kind": grid.kind,
        "seed_cert": cert,
        "request": None, "request_hash": None,
        "prev": g._last_hash, "ts": _now(),
    }
    from gallery_governance import MemberAddedRecord
    fake = MemberAddedRecord(
        world_id=g.world_id, slot=0,
        member_id=grid.world_id(),
        member_kind=grid.kind, seed_cert=cert,
        request=None, request_hash=None,
        prev=g._last_hash, ts=body["ts"],
        sig=k1.sign(_canonical(body)).hex(),  # K1 signs!

def test_rotation_and_revocation_together():

    x_kp = _kp()

    k2 = _kp()
    rec = g.rotate_keeper(k2)
    # Tamper: change old_keeper_id
    tampered = KeeperRotationRecord(
        world_id=rec.world_id,
        old_keeper_id="did:key:" + "00" * 32,
        new_keeper_id=rec.new_keeper_id,
        prev=rec.prev, ts=rec.ts,
        sig_old=rec.sig_old, sig_new=rec.sig_new)

    ok, reason = verify_revocable_governed_log(g)
    assert not ok
    assert "old keeper" in reason.lower()


def test_tampered_revocation_effective_at_fails():
    """If the effective_at is tampered, the verifier's check
    against record.ts will diverge."""
    g = _gallery()
    x_kp = _kp()
    x_key = g.issue_world_key(_did_from_kp(x_kp), "control")
    rec = g.revoke_world_key(x_key, "test")
    # Tamper effective_at to be far in the future
    tampered = WorldKeyRevokedRecord(
        world_id=rec.world_id,
        revoked_subject_id=rec.revoked_subject_id,
        key_hash=rec.key_hash, reason=rec.reason,
        effective_at="2099-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
        prev=rec.prev, ts=rec.ts, sig=rec.sig)
    g._records[-1] = tampered
    ok, _ = verify_revocable_governed_log(g)
    # The record's sig won't verify (tampered body), so it fails
    assert not ok
